results.remarks: Thoughtful design makes exceptional use of this oversized golf course property at Outdoor Resort Indio. This beautifully updated 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home offers the perfect blend of space, comfort, and resort-style living. Enjoy warm desert evenings beneath the custom pergola or gather around the real wood-burning fire pit while taking in breathtaking mountain views. Inside, the home showcases stylish 12x24 ceramic plank tile flooring throughout the main living areas, creating a modern and cohesive design. Located within the highly sought-after Talavera community, known for its parks, greenbelts, walking paths, and family-friendly atmosphere, this exceptional property delivers the ideal combination of indoor-outdoor living, functionality, and value. Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a beautifully upgraded home with incredible mountain views in one of North Indio's premier neighborhoods.

results.remarks: Move-in ready & loaded with upgrades, this 3 bedroom, 3 bath Boschetto home offers 2,549 square feet on an 8,276 SF lot in a prime location in the all-ages section of Trilogy at The Polo Club. The lot backs to the greenbelt & sits directly across from the clubhouse, pickleball courts & tennis courts. The home includes over $135,000 in original builder upgrades & a lot premium. Walk over for a morning game of pickleball, an evening at June Hill's Table, or a laid-back afternoon by the pool. Trilogy at The Polo Club is a guard-gated, socially active resort-style community centered around the 25,000+ square foot Polo Club clubhouse, with dining, a fitness center, pools, tennis courts & dozens of homeowner-led clubs, from golf and bocce to art, book club & beyond. Polo Club membership is available for transfer with this home. A stacked-stone & stucco exterior with a paver driveway and walkways sets the tone from the street. Inside, the open-concept great room features tray ceilings, ceiling fans, and a wall of windows with plantation shutters throughout. Disappearing pocket sliding doors at the great room and kitchen open completely to a covered, recessed-lit back patio. Perfect for morning coffee or evening dinners outdoors, framing the east-facing backyard, landscaped with low-maintenance artificial turf and mature trees, plus a gated rear yard entry.  The chef-caliber kitchen invites you to cook and gather with Cafe by GE stainless steel appliances, gas cooktop with stainless hood, quartz countertops with a waterfall-edge island, gray subway tile backsplash & white shaker-style cabinetry with a full wall of pantry storage. Upgraded wood-look tile flooring runs throughout the home. Retreat to the primary suite, where a walk-in closet, a French door out to the patio, & a bath with a soaking tub & curbless walk-in shower with bench seating create a private escape. A second bedroom offers an ensuite bath with quartz countertops & powder room with a pedestal sink. The large laundry room impresses with granite countertops, a laundry sink, two built-in desk areas, and abundant storage. Additional highlights include solar (financed, to be assumed or paid off at close of escrow), a 48-amp EV charger, & a tankless water heater combining comfort & efficiency. This is more than a home. It's a lifestyle across the street from it all. Come see why Trilogy at The Polo Club living means never running out of ways to spend your day.

results.remarks: Perched on an elevated lot with panoramic golf course and mountain views, this 2,168 sq ft 3-bedroom home has been remodeled from top to bottom at a level of detail that is hard to find!Starting with the kitchen, the heart of it all: gorgeous custom Alder cabinets, quartz counters, and marble backsplash surround a suite of GE Profile stainless appliances. A built-in wine fridge tucks under the peninsula, while a reverse osmosis system and instant water heater under the sink deliver purified hot and cold water directly to the faucet. Designer lighting throughout, including a motion-sensor lighting in the walk-in pantry, makes this space as functional as it is beautiful.The primary suite delivers a spa-caliber bathroom with an enormous new glass shower enclosure, triple shower heads, and porcelain tile floor to ceiling, alongside all-new vanities, fixtures, and lighting. LVP flooring flows through the bedroom and closet, complete with optional smart-voice fan and lighting controls. The secondary bathroom received the same top-to-bottom remodel, right down to the tile baseboards.Living spaces impress with surround sound, a dedicated AV/media closet, and a striking fireplace update featuring a quartz hearth, marble surround, and wood mantle. The second and third bedrooms both offer LVP flooring and optional smart-voice fan controls, while the front entry welcomes you with a fiberglass 4-lite panel door and touchpad deadbolt.Behind the scenes, the systems are just as impressive: both HVAC zones replaced with high-efficiency American Standard Platinum Series units, water heater recirculation pump, and a whole-house EcoWater softener system. The garage features built-in storage, ample lighting, and dual garage door openers.Outside is where the magic happens! Professional desert-friendly landscaping, drip irrigation, and a smart irrigation controller keep the yard efficient and beautiful, while a Koolfog misting system, outdoor speakers, and smart patio lighting extend the living space outdoors. Relax around the fire feature or in the custom pool and spa with its dramatic waterfall and updated color lighting for year-round enjoyment.This is a home where every detail has been considered -- smart, stylish, and ready for its next chapter in your life! All the hard work is done; paradise is here, awaiting you. View the videos and VR tour, then schedule a showing -- you'll be more impressed in person!

results.remarks: Tucked behind the gates of Palazzo in North Indio, this single story, 5 bedroom, 4 bath home delivers 3,022 square feet of upgraded living space that rarely comes on the market. Step inside and 12 foot ceilings set the tone for a home built with detail and craftsmanship throughout.Rich wood flooring, plantation shutters, custom built in wood entertainment centers, and integrated speakers run through the main living spaces. The gourmet kitchen anchors the home with granite counters, quality cabinetry, and a generous walk in pantry, built for both everyday living and hosting.The primary suite is privately set apart from the secondary bedrooms and includes a spa style bath with a soaking tub, walk in shower, dual vanities, and an oversized walk in closet.Out back you'll find a sparkling pool and spa, a firepit for cool desert evenings, and a covered patio with ceiling fans perfect for entertaining or unwinding. Solar panels, paired with the lower rates of the IID (Imperial Irrigation District) utility service, help keep energy costs in check year-round.North Indio is one of Riverside County's fastest growing cities and the Palazzo community sits just off Monroe Street north of Avenue 42, in one of the Coachella Valley's most convenient corners. Festival goers will appreciate being just around the corner from the Empire Polo Club, home to Coachella and Stagecoach, and a short drive gets you to Acrisure Arena for concerts and events, and to El Paseo's upscale dining and shopping in Palm Desert.Between the freeway access, the shopping and entertainment nearby, and the privacy of a gated community, this Palazzo home offers a rare combination of convenience and quiet luxury.  You have to see it in person to appreciate all this home has to offer.  Schedule your showing today!

results.remarks: Experience elevated desert living in this beautifully upgraded, move-in ready home designed for effortless indoor-outdoor living. From the moment you arrive, the extensive custom paver hardscaping set the tone for a low-maintenance yet highly refined outdoor environment.The backyard is a true private retreat, showcasing a saltwater pool and spa with a stunning flagstone beach entry-creating a rare, resort-inspired setting perfect for both relaxation and entertaining. An outdoor shower with handheld fixture, set against a striking stacked-stone wall, adds a spa-like touch, while professionally designed landscaping features mature palm and citrus trees, including Meyer lemon and lime, and ambient lighting for magical desert evenings. A remote-controlled retractable awning provides shaded comfort, allowing you to enjoy the space year-round. Inside, the home is thoughtfully upgraded for both comfort and style, featuring wide-plank laminate flooring throughout (no carpet), crown molding, LED recessed lighting and surround sound speakers in the great room. Natural light fills the home through well-placed solar tubes in the kitchen, laundry and primary closet, enhancing the bright and welcoming atmosphere.The kitchen is designed to impress with quartz counters, full-height 42-inch cabinetry, an upgraded tile backsplash, and stainless steel KitchenAid appliances-perfectly blending functionality with modern design.The primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with a sliding glass door providing direct access to the pool and backyard, along with a barn door entry to the en-suite bath.  Additional features include custom wood shutters, room-darkening window treatments and ceiling fans throughout.Practical upgrades provide peace of mind, including a newer Lennox HVAC system (approx. 2 years old), a tankless water heater (approx. 1 year old), and a mini-split system in the garage-ideal for added comfort and flexibility.  The garage is equally well appointed with epoxy finished flooring and overhead storage.This home seamlessly combines modern upgrades, energy efficiency and a resort-style outdoor living-offering the ultimate desert lifestyle. Residents of Sun City Shadow Hills enjoy resort-style amenities including golf, clubhouses, fitness centers, pools, tennis, pickleball, dining, and a vibrant social lifestyle--all with low HOA dues.

results.remarks: This expanded Lennar built Merion model in Heritage Palms Country Club is one of the community's most sought after floor plans, and for good reason. From its inviting front courtyard to the expansive golf course and mountain views beyond, it offers the kind of indoor outdoor desert living buyers are searching for.The welcoming courtyard, complete with mature landscaping, paver walkway, seating areas, and a peaceful fountain, creates a warm first impression and an additional outdoor living space to enjoy year round.Inside, the open main living area captures sweeping golf course views and distant clubhouse vistas the moment you enter. Beautiful tile flooring runs throughout the great room and main living spaces, adding both elegance and durability, while hardwood flooring in the kitchen brings warmth and character.The great room is anchored by a stunning custom built in designed to accommodate a large screen TV while showcasing art, books, and collectibles. Plantation shutters throughout further elevate the home's timeless style.The thoughtfully designed kitchen features double ovens, stainless appliances, granite counters and backsplash, a large pantry, and an oversized island with bar seating for four. It opens seamlessly to the gathering space, making it ideal for entertaining.The spacious primary suite includes a door to the patio, custom closet, and a double vanity in the bathroom. The third bedroom offers flexibility and can easily function as either a true bedroom or a den, depending on your needs.Step outside to a serene east facing rear patio overlooking the golf course, where morning light, mountain views, and long sight lines across the fairway to the clubhouse create a truly special setting.Located within the sought after 55+ active adult community of Heritage Palms, residents enjoy access to a championship golf course, clubhouse, fitness center, tennis and pickleball courts, indoor and outdoor pools, dining, and a vibrant social calendar that makes this community one of the desert's most desirable country club lifestyles.

results.remarks: Turnkey desert retreat, income-producing opportunity, and one of the few remaining homes in a sought-after short-term-rental-friendly community. Perfectly positioned just minutes from the Empire Polo Grounds, home of the world-famous Coachella and Stagecoach festivals, this property offers the rare combination of lifestyle, location, and investment potential.Adding to its appeal, qualified buyers may have the opportunity to assume the existing low-interest loan (subject to lender approval), creating a substantial financial advantage in today's higher-rate environment.The highly desirable Gallery floor plan was designed for effortless indoor-outdoor living, featuring an open-concept great room with fireplace, spacious dining area, and an entertainer's kitchen complete with granite countertops, white cabinetry, oversized center island, and walk-in pantry. With strong year-round demand, an unbeatable location near major events, resort-style amenities, and the potential benefit of an assumable low-rate loan, this is a rare opportunity to secure both a lifestyle asset and a smart investment in one of the Coachella Valley's most desirable communities.

results.remarks: Experience the perfect blend of modern sophistication and desert tranquility in this meticulously upgraded ''Liberty'' floor plan within the prestigious Trilogy Polo Club (A 55+ Community). results.remarks: Welcome to Ozark Oasis, a proven, income-producing short-term rental opportunity in the heart of the Coachella Valley. This fully furnished 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom property has been thoughtfully designed to deliver the resort-style amenities today's vacation rental guests are looking for, while offering an attractive opportunity for investors seeking an established cash-flowing asset.According to the property manager, the home generated approximately $127,000 in gross rental revenue in 2025, already has approximately $87,000 on the books for 2026, and has nearly $60,000 in future bookings--providing the next owner with immediate revenue potential.The property features a newer 30' x 15' pool and spa, newer outdoor firepit areas, putting green, outdoor kitchen with built-in BBQ, multiple outdoor entertaining and dining areas, and a dedicated garage game room with its own mini-split HVAC system. The game room is loaded with entertainment, including a pool table, shuffleboard, skee-ball, Golden Tee and NFL Blitz, creating another major guest amenity and revenue driver.Ideally positioned near some of the Coachella Valley's largest tourism and entertainment draws, including the Coachella and Stagecoach festivals, BNP Paribas Open tennis tournament, golf, and Acrisure Arena, the property benefits from year-round demand generators in one of Southern California's premier vacation destinations.This opportunity is particularly well suited for STR investors, 1031 exchange buyers, and investors looking to potentially take advantage of cost segregation and bonus depreciation strategies. Consult your tax professional regarding eligibility and individual tax benefits.Sold turnkey furnished, allowing a buyer to step into an established vacation rental with furnishings, amenities and future bookings already in place. No HOA rental restrictions. Buyer to independently verify City of Indio short-term rental permitting requirements, transferability, rental history, future reservations and all applicable STR regulations.Whether you're looking to expand an existing vacation-rental portfolio, complete a 1031 exchange, or acquire a proven Coachella Valley property with strong historical revenue, Ozark Oasis offers the rare combination of location, amenities, established bookings and immediate income potential.

results.remarks:
Some homes are simply a place to live. This one is where the entire family comes together!
Welcome to one of the largest and most sought-after floor plans in Terra Lago's Four Seasons premier 55+ community—a rare opportunity for those who love having family close, entertaining often, and living comfortably year-round.
Offering 3 spacious bedrooms, a large den easily utilized as a fourth bedroom, and 3 full bathrooms, this thoughtfully designed residence provides room for everyone. Whether it's grandchildren visiting for the weekend, adult children staying for the holidays, or friends gathering for a desert getaway, there's space for everyone to spread out and feel at home. The open-concept layout was designed for connection. A generous chef's kitchen anchors the heart of the home, flowing seamlessly into the dining and great room, creating the perfect setting for holiday dinners, game nights, family celebrations, or quiet evenings with loved ones. Freshly painted and impeccably maintained, this home is truly move-in ready and available fully or partially
furnished. Step outside and discover your own private desert retreat. The newly resurfaced heated saltwater pool, tranquil fountain, cooling misters, covered patio, outdoor fans, and custom landscape lighting create an atmosphere that feels more like a resort than a backyard. Low-maintenance turf and mature landscaping allow you to spend less time working and more time enjoying. Additional highlights include dual-zone climate control with two AC systems, energy-efficient construction, a 2-car garage plus dedicated golf cart garage, and convenient single-story living with no interior stairs. Beyond your front door, Four Seasons offers an exceptional resort-style lifestyle with multiple pools, a state-of-the-art fitness center, pickleball, tennis, basketball, bocce ball, clubhouse activities, dog park, and 24-hour gated security.
This is more than a home—it's the place where birthdays are celebrated, holidays are hosted, grandchildren make memories, and family always has room to stay. Because the best part of retirement isn't having less space. It's having enough space for the people who matter most. SELLERS OFFERING BRAND NEW GOLF CART with full price offer!

Step inside to discover a spacious, open floor plan designed for both everyday comfort and effortless entertaining. The expansive kitchen features abundant cabinetry, generous counter space, a center island with bar seating, stainless steel appliances, and seamlessly flows into the dining area and great room. results.L_Remarks: Experience resort-style living in this beautifully maintained Monaco floor plan located behind the gates of the highly sought-after adult community of Trilogy at the Polo Club (55+).  Perfectly positioned to capture breathtaking mountain views, this exceptional home showcases stunning Santa Rosa vistas from the great room, den and primary suite, while the front courtyard and kitchen offer picturesque San Bernardino Mountain views.  An inviting courtyard with perennial flower beds and privacy hedge creates an impressive welcome.  Located within walking distance to the Polo Club.  Inside the open -concept design is filled with natural light and offers comfortable living spaces ideal for entertaining and everyday enjoyment.  The Monaco plan includes unique architectural details and oversized windows to bring the indoor/outdoor feeling to every room.  The spacious great room with dining area is accessed through the entry foyer and flows seamlessly to into the gourmet kitchen with upgraded built-in GE cook top and oven, featuring a large center island, counter seating, abundant cabinetry with under lights and a casual dining space with curved linear widows overlooking the front courtyard.  The den with oversized windows captures mountain views and provides flexible space for an office, sitting or hobby area.  The primary suite is a peaceful retreat with spectacular mountain views, a large walk-in closet, a beautifully appointed ensuite bathroom dual vanity and large shower with integrated seat.  A separate versatile guest bedroom with adjacent full bathroom provides flexible space for visitors.  Step outside to the expansive south facing backyard designed for year-round living.  Enjoy the covered patio with ceiling fan, attractive paver landscape, accented by planters and gas BBQ connection; all framed by Santa Rosa Mountain views and vibrant sunrises & sunsets.  Additional features include an indoor laundry room, attached two car garage with ample storage, energy efficient construction including a tankless hot water heater along with low maintenance landscaping allowing you to spend more time enjoying the community exceptional amenities.  Trilogy at the Polo Club offers an unmatched active adult lifestyle with a spectacular clubhouse including June Hill's Table Restaurant overlooking the lake and Santa Rosa Mountains.  The Polo Club offers a vibrant calendar of club activities and social events.  Polo Club membership is available to transfer for $3,000.

results.remarks: Located in the highly desirable Sun City Shadow Hills Phase 3, a premier 55+ active adult community, this exceptional Hospitality model offers 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and approximately 1,756 square feet of beautifully upgraded living space and an oversized corner lot. Pride of ownership is evident throughout this stunning home.Step inside to find high-end wood-look ceramic tile flooring in all main living areas, complemented by upgraded cabinetry, custom paint, and elegant baseboards throughout. The open-concept floor plan creates an ideal setting for both everyday living and entertaining.The gourmet kitchen is a chef's delight, featuring stainless steel appliances, slab granite countertops, a large center island with seating, and a striking custom tile backsplash. It opens seamlessly to a spacious dining area with views of the beautifully landscaped backyard. The inviting Great Room is anchored by a cozy gas fireplace with a custom mantle.The primary suite is a private retreat, offering a spa-like bathroom with dual vanities, a soaking tub, a separate walk-in shower, and a mirrored entry to the generous walk-in closet. Two additional guest bedrooms, each with their own closets and plush high-end carpeting, are conveniently located near the guest bathroom with a tub/shower combination. Additional upgrades include recessed LED lighting, custom window treatments and ceiling fans with lights.  A separate laundry room adds convenience.The backyard is truly an entertainer's dream, showcasing a one-of-a-kind lot and custom landscaping with high-end lighting. Enjoy outdoor living under the covered patio complete with heater and shades, all overlooking a custom gas fire pit and tranquil rock waterfall feature. Additional extended paver patio areas provide multiple seating spaces, while the low-maintenance, colorful landscaping offers beauty and ease.The garage is equally impressive, featuring a mini-split A/C system, insulated garage door, epoxy-coated flooring, and built-in storage.Residents of Sun City Shadow Hills enjoy resort-style amenities including golf, pickleball, tennis, pools, spas, fitness centers, clubs, dining, and a vibrant social calendar.This is more than a home--it's a lifestyle.
